title: The Software Directory Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Software names, purposes, platforms, pricing, and official websites. The Software Directory Database catalogs software with names, purposes, supported platforms, pricing models, and official websites, so students can find the right tool without wading through ads. Records note free tiers and student pricing where published. The Signature side adds purpose-matching that routes a task description to suitable software.
capabilities: Catalog software with purpose, platforms, and pricing
Link to official websites, never download mirrors
Note free tiers and student pricing where published
Match task descriptions to suitable software
Track pricing-model changes over time

title: The Software Directory Database — Connection layer: public to Signature record mapping
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. The connection layer links records across both sides. Public record JAH-CDB-SOFTWARE-NNNNNN maps to Signature record JAH-CDBS-SOFTWARE-NNNNNN by shared record number; provenance is tracked per record and never mixed. The student AI searches both sides through this mapping.
